texts.zh:
我们已经从[FromFromFrom.GetShipSizeName]所在的[FromFrom.solar_system.GetName]星系中获得了该生物的遗传物质。

虽然我们目前无法克隆这种生物，但我们仍然可以从其独特的生物学特性中提取宝贵的见解。
texts.en:
We have recovered the genetic material of the [FromFromFrom.GetShipSizeName] we encountered in [FromFrom.solar_system.GetName].

Though we lack the understandings to clone such a creature, we may still be able to extract valuable insight from its unique biology.

texts.zh: 我们从虚空孳孽身上提取的遗传物质为我们提供了一些独特的见解，这将使我们能够进行一项实验性突变项目，该项目可以应用于任何太空兽群。
texts.en: The genetic material we have recovered from the Voidspawn has provided some unique insight that will allow us to proceed with an experimental mutation project that could be applied to any Space Fauna.

title.zh: 虚空孳孽变异计划完成

texts.zh:
我们使用虚空孳孽基因材料进行的变异实验完成了，得到了一个有趣的发现：星养生理

这些生物的组织对星光反应强烈，可以被鼓励在其他生物体中生长。这需要少量能量来维持，但在最亮的恒星附近，它们的生长速度会大幅提高。
texts.en:
Our experimental mutation project using Voidspawn genetic material is complete, and has yielded an interesting discovery: Starborne Biology

The tissue of these creatures reacts strongly to starlight, and can be encouraged to grow in other organisms. This demands a small amount of energy to maintain, but vastly improves their growth rate near the brightest stars.
